svg.title: Amycretin’s headline weight loss: one small, single-site trial
svg.desc: Estimated average weight change, amycretin vs placebo, phase 1b/2a trial (Lancet 2025). Part B 60 mg: −24.3% vs −1.1% at 36 weeks. Part C 20 mg: −22.0% vs +1.9% at 36 weeks. Part D 5 mg: −16.2% vs +2.3% at 28 weeks. Part E 1.25 mg: −9.7% vs +2.0% at 20 weeks. 125 people were randomized, 24 of them to placebo across five parts, at one clinic in San Antonio.
